rationale: SVP Engineering principle — operational simplicity through reduced moving parts
description: Archive of 30 individual skills consolidated into 5 canonical skills

graph-analysis.description: Unified AST dependency graph analysis for tier-aware investigation, impact analysis, scope validation, and duplicate prevention

boundary-enforcement.description: Consolidated layer boundary and import hygiene enforcement

operational-gates.description: Consolidated operational gates including rollback checkpoints and MCP tool validation

testing-framework.description: Consolidated testing enforcement covering test rigor, collection integrity, execution counts, and skip management

artifact-management.description: Consolidated artifact management including evidence capture, path validation, and progress display

restoration_procedure: Copy desired skill directory from tools/archive/.windsurf/skills/ back to .windsurf/skills/
Update RULES_INDEX.md to include restored skill
Verify CI gates pass after restoration
